content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Smart Casts and Type Narrowing** as part of **Null Safety and Type Handling**. Apply smart casts and type narrowing by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Smart Casts After Type Checks, Smart Casts with Nullable Values, Conditions Required for Smart Casts—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Functions, null safety, strings, and collections are the building blocks of most practical Kotlin code. Choosing the right operation reduces avoidable errors and makes behavior easier to test.

items.title: Smart Casts with Nullable Values
items.text: Smart Casts with Nullable Values is about representing or handling the possibility that a value is absent. Keep nullability visible in the type and choose an explicit fallback, branch, or result model rather than assuming the value exists.
